synonym_caution: The current POWO Z. texana taxon page displays no synonym list; do not infer that no historic names have ever been published. Separately verify any future proposed synonym.
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — accepted taxon name does not certify individual learner images
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid or introgression status established
install_decision: Existing accepted learner species; do not create duplicate Zizania cards or collapse accepted species

decisions.subject: Zizania texana Hitchc.
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED species in genus Zizania, family Poaceae; retain existing learner binomial
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts the species; FWS independently uses this exact binomial.

decisions.subject: Zizania texana authorship and protologue
decisions.proposed_decision: Use Hitchc.; originally published J. Wash. Acad. Sci. 23:454 (1933)
decisions.detail: Do not append authorship of other Zizania species or assign infraspecific rank.

decisions.subject: Zizania species concept under WCVP
decisions.proposed_decision: Four separately accepted species: Z. texana, Z. palustris, Z. aquatica, Z. latifolia
decisions.detail: The four accepted species are not aliases for a single wild-rice card.

decisions.subject: Zizania palustris L.
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED species, separate from Z. texana
decisions.detail: Its phylogenetic proximity to Z. texana does not by itself make it a synonym.

decisions.subject: Zizania aquatica L.
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED species, separate from Z. texana
decisions.detail: Common name wild rice alone does not establish species identity.

decisions.subject: Zizania aquatica var. angustifolia Hitchc.
decisions.proposed_decision: SYNONYM_TO_ACCEPTED: Zizania palustris L., NOT Z. texana
decisions.detail: POWO also maps Z. aquatica subsp. angustifolia (Hitchc.) Tzvelev to Z. palustris.

decisions.subject: Zizania aquatica var. interior Fassett
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED infraspecific under Z. aquatica, not an infraspecific of Z. texana
decisions.detail: Preserve full species and rank in historic wild-rice names.

decisions.subject: Texas wild-rice life history
decisions.proposed_decision: Perennial aquatic grass is supported by POWO taxon summary, USFWS and 2017 genetics study
decisions.detail: A conflicting GrassBase text fragment is separately recorded as a metadata inconsistency; do not replace verified perennial with annual.

decisions.subject: Z. texana morphological species comparison
decisions.proposed_decision: Published cultivation-based comparisons reported stable differences from Z. aquatica and Z. palustris
decisions.detail: 1978 peer-reviewed abstract supports maintaining a separate operational species concept; does not authenticate any current photo.

decisions.subject: Molecular relationship of Z. texana and Z. palustris
decisions.proposed_decision: Close relationship supported, not synonymy or individual hybrid status
decisions.detail: 2010 organellar/nuclear study and 2015 population data support close phylogenetic affinity while both studies retain four named species.

decisions.subject: Automatic Z. texana -> Z. palustris mapping
decisions.proposed_decision: REJECT proposed species collapse or relabeling of individual Texas wild-rice records
decisions.detail: 2015 STRUCTURE overlap at sampled markers is not a nomenclatural act and does not override the accepted POWO/WCVP treatment.

decisions.subject: Automatic Z. texana -> Z. aquatica mapping
decisions.proposed_decision: REJECT broad wild-rice synonymization based on common name, aquatic habit or historical varieties
decisions.detail: Separate accepted species and published morphological differences; historic Z. aquatica infraspecifics must be resolved by their own full names.

decisions.subject: Existing Z. texana learner images and source observations
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve source-labelled identification; no new specimen-level certainty without voucher or reliable source determination
decisions.detail: Taxonomy of accepted species does not independently verify the eight source-labelled photos; do not alter photos, labels, or gallery.

decisions.subject: Hybrid, introgression or clone ancestry of individual Z. texana plants
decisions.proposed_decision: No individual hybrid/genotype assignment without specimen-specific evidence
decisions.detail: 2010 low-frequency introgression signal concerns Z. palustris into Z. aquatica, not proof of hybrid origin for a Texas wild-rice learner photograph.

decisions.subject: GrassBase annual versus POWO/FWS perennial life-history metadata
decisions.proposed_decision: Flag inconsistent source text for specialist source correction; use perennial for accepted species pending reconciliation
decisions.detail: POWO taxon summary says perennial but its embedded GrassBase description begins 'Annual'; source-level discrepancy not a taxonomic reclassification.

decisions.subject: 2015 Z. texana versus Z. palustris microsatellite cluster overlap
decisions.proposed_decision: Document unresolved resolution at sampled molecular markers; keep accepted species separate
decisions.detail: 2015 STRUCTURE K=3 did not resolve Z. texana as a distinct cluster from Z. palustris. This is a phylogenetic limitation, not grounds to erase accepted names.

sources.authority: Terrell, Emery & Beaty (1978), Bulletin of the Torrey Botanical Club 105:50–57
Xu et al. (2010), Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution
Comparative phylogeography of Zizania (2015), American Journal of Botany
GrassBase description reproduced by POWO (conflicting life-history phrase)

scope_exclusions: No photo sourcing or photo identity assertions
